evaluation_scope: Post-freeze air-gapped physical state comparison (`01-Basic` `test/physical.zip`). Offline evaluation only.
epistemic_boundary: Compares frozen network transitions with nearest 1-second simulator snapshots. Reports exact numeric agreement, tolerance agreement, and de-energized NaN compatibility separately. Does not verify a physical causal graph, and does not feed physical.zip into reconstruction.

comparison_criteria.semantic_deenergized_nan_vs_iec104_zero: A non-finite simulator post-value (NaN) together with a network post-value within 1e-3 of zero is semantic compatibility for a de-energized island. It is not numeric equality.
comparison_criteria.to_zero_pre: Network pre-value is compared to the physical pre-snapshot under the bridge numeric rule. Presence of a finite physical pre-value is not agreement.
comparison_criteria.to_zero_post: Network post-value near zero is either a numeric match to a finite physical post-value or semantic NaN compatibility. An unchecked post-value is not agreement.
comparison_criteria.alignment: Each network time is paired with the nearest 1-second simulator snapshot. alignment_error_seconds = snapshot_time - target_time. Values are not interpolated.
comparison_criteria.physical_zip_isolation: physical.zip is opened only by this offline evaluation. Reconstruction inputs exclude it.

withheld_no_pre_baseline_transaction_che.finding: The offline simulator shows a pre/post change whose post-value matches the reported COT=3 sample. This physical observation does not promote the transaction to verified.

mitm_cross_vantage_conflict_quarantine_c.network_side_finding: The frozen reconstruction, which did not read physical.zip, quarantined 671 anchors after `_merge_iec_vantages()` marked cross-vantage payload conflicts.
mitm_cross_vantage_conflict_quarantine_c.physical_sample_finding: Three nearest snapshots show switch.21 closed, closed, then open, and sgen.12 active power near 14000 W, near 14000 W, then 0 W. That pattern is compatible with an opening between the early-window and late-window samples. It does not show that the opening occurred once, that power remained 0 W, or that each of the 671 quarantined anchors is a false physical event.
